noise_plan.replica_rule: slot=5*replicate_index+bin_index; start=file_start+512+32*slot; both families share a paired noise window
noise_plan.geocent_time_rule: start+12.2; translate full pilot time prior by truth_time minus real event_GPS
noise_plan.PSD_rule: Frozen reader chooses first 256s all-flag/finiteness-passing block in same file; require common block end<=first analysis start before any allocated jobs
noise_plan.scope: Filename geometry only; common PSD and paired noise imply cross-job dependence, never count as independent exposure/time.

distance_rescale.scope: Algebra only. rho0 unknown and changes with family, GPS, sky and PSD. Per-job checks remain mandatory.

missing_inputs.required: After-pilot cost, terminal convergence/acceptance receipt and family/configuration comparison, with hashes. Do not read/assume new pilot posterior in this preparation.
E3.2 actual remaining 40h budget, N per family/bin, maxcall and wall per job, stopping precision, all five alternatives costed. Candidate carries null wall/maxcall deliberately.

Future authorized metadata/DQ verification of pinned H1/L1 offsource file extents, common valid 16s windows and flags; PSD first valid 256s block must end before earliest planned analysis window. No strain read here.

At execution, family/time/sky-specific reference optimal SNR at D0=500 Mpc and registered PSD/band; Dnew=D0*rho0/target strictly inside (100,2000). Freeze infeasible-bin disposition before results; never widen prior to obtain a pass.

Ratify arbitrary aligned source point and five SNR-bin targets as INPUT or provide a predeclared source grid; one source/one epoch is not population calibration. LVK metadata contains no recoverable physical truth vector.

Independent analysis specification: per-family/bin bias, paired covariance, uncertainty on c, within/between-family df scatter, coverage levels and binomial intervals, failures counted, precision/stop criterion and systematic-gate computation. No such campaign results claimed.
Populate E2_PE_JOBS_V2 jobs, parent registration hash, unique names/output dirs/seeds, config SHA, ORCAMENTO_40H allocation and tunnel witness before jobs. Do not replace existing jobs or edit E2.

For nonzero a=1 candidates, per-reading/per-mode remnant/QNM/clock/redshift provenance, signed-spin admissibility, deformation convention and truth support, with 220-only versus 220+440 INPUT explicit. No values computed here.

Keep recovery all four deviations free. XPHM non-GR/precessing truths, stochastic unravelings, exact coherent/propagation signals, fixed-deformation recovery and new event GPS anchors are unsupported by this frozen path; separate reviewed/versioned implementation if later authorized.
